fresh_PR_readback.body:
Final disposition: **already_solved; closed without merge or a new preprint**.

The original claimed_solved2/5 endpoint counterexample passes the mathematical audit. Three independent priority families identified the same endpoint resolution and algebraically identical mean-zero edge bubble in Kreuzer–Veeser, arXiv:1903.05915v1 (14 March2019), published2021, DOI10.1007/s00211-021-01194-8. Lemma21 plus Lemma4(ii) gives the actual global best-P0 obstruction; formula(3.19b) matches the submitted bubble up normalization.

The explicit logarithmic lower bound follows by a further elementary allocation inequality from the credited CDN construction and existing KV bridge. Useful verification and exposition improvements were checked, but no substantive novel mathematical contribution has been established.

The [detailed closure audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/154#issuecomment-6118299650) records source locators, the global norm inference, an omitted overlay step in the earlier proof and its repair, quantitative scope and bounded nonmaterial access gaps.

Original submitted head58bee8514677549ee5a7cd699028a5f3a616c5bc and effort2/5 are preserved; the author branch is unchanged. No new DOI or tracker row is created. The scoped MAIN findings/QUEUE checkpoint remains pending repository coordination. Extensive AI assistance; unrefereed checks, no conventional human peer review.
